fullTextEN: Hello,
I am Xika from Taiwan,
How are you all?

fullTextZH: 上一集的故事里我们聊到周杰伦小时候就很喜欢音乐，
fullTextEN: In the last episode's story, we talked about how Jay Chou loved music since childhood,
He had a great talent for music,

fullTextZH: 他的妈妈看到他很有音乐天分，
fullTextEN: His mother saw that he had a great talent for music,
so she forced him to practice piano every day,

fullTextZH: 所以周杰伦弹钢琴弹得很好，
fullTextEN: so Jay Chou played the piano very well,

fullTextZH: 也让他变成女同学心目中的白马王子。
fullTextEN: and he became the prince charming in the hearts of his female classmates.

fullTextZH: 今天我想告诉你他离开学校后怎样努力工作的故事。
fullTextEN: Today I want to tell you the story of how he worked hard after leaving school.

fullTextZH: 很快他就要高中毕业了，
fullTextEN: Soon he was about to graduate from high school,

fullTextZH: 他的同学都在准备考大学，
fullTextEN: His classmates were all preparing for university exams,
Jay Chou was also preparing for university exams,

fullTextZH: 他想考台北大学的音乐系，
fullTextEN: He wanted to apply to the music department of Taipei University,
but his grades were not good,
He took the exam twice but didn't pass.

fullTextZH: 那个时候的台湾社会认为，
fullTextEN: At that time, Taiwanese society believed that,

fullTextZH: 一个人要有好的成绩才能考上好学校，
fullTextEN: a person needed good grades to get into a good school,
to be able to find a good job.
What about music?

fullTextZH: 是有钱人才能玩的东西。
fullTextEN: It's something only rich people can play with.

fullTextZH: 像周杰伦这样来自普通家庭的孩子，
fullTextEN: Like Jay Chou, a child from an ordinary family,
If you only know music,
there is no future,
you just can't find a job,
and you can't earn money.
Sure enough,
Jay Chou graduated from high school,
he had no university to attend,
and couldn't find a job,

fullTextZH: 他只好先去餐厅当服务生。
fullTextEN: so he had to work as a waiter in a restaurant.
But he often made mistakes,
so he was often scolded by customers,
and often had his salary deducted by the boss.
For example,
his salary was 100 yuan,
but because he didn't do well,

fullTextZH: 所以老板没有给他 100 块，
fullTextEN: the boss didn't give him 100 yuan,
only gave him 50 yuan.

fullTextZH: 但是周杰伦一直没有放弃音乐。
fullTextEN: But Jay Chou never gave up on music.

fullTextZH: 他把他的薪水都拿去买音乐录音带。
fullTextEN: He spent all his salary on buying music tapes.
When he has time,
he writes songs.

fullTextZH: 他一直希望他写的歌能让那些很红的歌星唱。
fullTextEN: He always hoped that the songs he wrote could be sung by famous singers.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦和同学一起去参加选秀节目。
fullTextEN: Jay Chou and his classmates went to participate in a talent show.

fullTextZH: 选秀节目就是让普通人去参加，
fullTextEN: A talent show is where ordinary people participate,
and then become famous through the show,
Jay Chou was responsible for playing the piano,
and his classmate sang.

fullTextZH: 虽然同学唱歌没有得奖，
fullTextEN: Although the classmate didn't win any awards,

fullTextZH: 但是当时的节目主持人也是音乐公司的老板，
fullTextEN: the host of the show at that time was also the boss of a music company,
His name is Jacky Wu,
he discovered,
um,

fullTextZH: 这个年轻人的态度很认真，
fullTextEN: that this young man's attitude was very serious,
and his style was also very unique,

fullTextZH: 所以他给了周杰伦一份工作，
fullTextEN: so he gave Jay Chou a job,

fullTextZH: 这份工作就是到他的公司写歌，
fullTextEN: which was to write songs at his company,
So there are three years.

fullTextZH: 周杰伦在台北一间小小的录音室一直写一直写，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou kept writing and writing in a small recording studio in Taipei,
He wrote many, many songs,

fullTextZH: 他真的很希望他写的歌能让那些明星歌手唱，
fullTextEN: He really hoped that the songs he wrote could be sung by those star singers,

fullTextZH: 他甚至觉得不要给我钱都没关系，
fullTextEN: He even felt that it didn't matter if he didn't get paid,
Please take them and sing.

fullTextZH: 但是周杰伦的音乐很特别，
fullTextEN: But Jay Chou's music is very special,
Too special,

fullTextZH: 那个时候很多人都觉得他的音乐很奇怪，
fullTextEN: At that time, many people thought his music was very strange,
and didn't want to sing his songs.

fullTextZH: 听说他曾经写了一首歌想给当时的明星刘德华唱，
fullTextEN: It's said he once wrote a song for the then-star Andy Lau to sing,
but it was rejected.

fullTextZH: 他也曾经写了一首歌想给台湾的歌手张惠妹唱，
fullTextEN: He also once wrote a song for Taiwanese singer A-Mei to sing,

fullTextZH: 他觉得张惠妹看起来比较可以接受风格特别的音乐，
fullTextEN: He thought A-Mei seemed more able to accept music with a special style,
but A-Mei also rejected it.

fullTextZH: 他的老板吴宗宪把他的音乐推荐给其他歌星好几次，
fullTextEN: His boss Jacky Wu recommended his music to other stars several times,
but it was always rejected.

fullTextZH: 没有人想唱周杰伦写的歌。
fullTextEN: No one wanted to sing the songs Jay Chou wrote.

fullTextZH: 可是吴宗宪看这个年轻人这么努力，
fullTextEN: But Jacky Wu saw this young man working so hard,
so earnest,
Decided to give him a chance.
He told Jay Chou,

fullTextZH: 如果你可以在 10 天之内写出 50 首歌给我，
fullTextEN: If you can write 50 songs for me in 10 days,

fullTextZH: 我会选 10 首帮你出唱片。
fullTextEN: I will choose 10 songs to help you release an album.
Jay Chou was extremely happy to hear this,

fullTextZH: 不过他没有马上开始工作。
fullTextEN: but he didn't start working immediately.
He first went to buy a box of instant noodles,
then returned to the recording studio.
For work, these 10 days,
he slept at the company,
and ate instant noodles when hungry.
He worked very, very hard to write,

fullTextZH: 他知道这是非常非常重要的一次机会
fullTextEN: he knew this was a very, very important opportunity
and possibly the last one.
10 days later,

fullTextZH: 他真的写完了 50 首歌，
fullTextEN: he really finished writing 50 songs,
and gave them to Jacky Wu,

fullTextZH: 吴宗宪选了 10 首出来让周杰伦自己唱。
fullTextEN: Jacky Wu selected 10 songs for Jay Chou to sing himself.
In November 2000,

fullTextZH: 周杰伦出了第一张唱片，
fullTextEN: Jay Chou released his first album,

fullTextZH: 唱片的名字叫做《Jay 》就是他的英文名字
fullTextEN: The album's name is 'Jay', which is his English name.

fullTextZH: 你猜猜周杰伦在 10 天之内写出来的歌品质怎么样呢？
fullTextEN: Can you guess the quality of the songs Jay Chou wrote in 10 days?
Will everyone like it?

fullTextZH: 答案是他的唱片非常受欢迎，
fullTextEN: The answer is his album was very popular,
sold 500,000 copies,
and even won an award.

fullTextZH: 里面有好几首歌都很经典，
fullTextEN: There are several classic songs in it,
even though a long time has passed,
everyone still likes them.
Up to now, in 2024,

fullTextZH: 很多人去 KTV 都还会点这些歌来唱。
fullTextEN: many people still choose these songs to sing at KTV.

fullTextZH: 这就是周杰伦成名的故事。
fullTextEN: This is the story of how Jay Chou became famous.

fullTextZH: 从一个没有人知道的餐厅服务生，
fullTextEN: From an unknown restaurant waiter,

fullTextZH: 突然变成许多人的偶像。
fullTextEN: suddenly becoming an idol for many people.
And from 2000 to now,

fullTextZH: 他的音乐还是有很多人喜欢。
fullTextEN: many people still like his music.
After hearing the story,

fullTextZH: 你想不想去听听这张唱片《Jay》 呢？
fullTextEN: do you want to listen to the album 'Jay'?

fullTextZH: 欢迎分享你最喜欢哪一首歌。
fullTextEN: Feel free to share which song you like the most.
Next,

fullTextZH: 我们还会继续分享更多关于周杰伦的故事。
fullTextEN: We will continue to share more stories about Jay Chou.
Please look forward to it!
See you next time,
Bye!
